name: Tachibana Serebu
source:
Serebu is a transfer student to class 2-C at beginning of the second term. She carries a samurai sword named Manjushage and wears dog tag with silencer. She is [url=/c102]Heizo's[/url] niece and she has superhuman athletic capability too.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tsuyokiss]Wikipedia[/url]]
